detail.command:
set -e
echo '--- head and parents ---'
git log --oneline -1
git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD
git log --oneline -1 --format='%H %p'
echo '--- merged branches contain incoming commit? ---'
git merge-base --is-ancestor 87e05bb601a988545be09272d01c792629279b49 HEAD && echo 'YES: 87e05bb is an ancestor of HEAD'
git merge-base --is-ancestor 012ffb90c6c91afd0be84e73d07ce4a07a511c7a HEAD && echo 'YES: 012ffb9 (office) is an ancestor of HEAD'
echo '--- working tree clean? ---'
git status --short; echo '(empty = clean)'
echo '--- conflict markers in tree ---'
git grep -n -E '^(<<<<<<<|>>>>>>>|=======)$' || echo none
echo '===== typecheck ====='; npm run typecheck
echo '===== test ====='; npm test
echo '===== build ====='; npm run build
echo '===== ALL CHECKS PASSED ====='
